create_visualizer: create a Visualizer instance to draw tracked points on video frames with configurable color modes
run_visualize: run the Visualizer.visualize method to overlay tracks and visibility on a video tensor and save as MP4
run_draw_tracks_on_video: run draw_tracks_on_video to render colored track lines and circles on each frame of an input video
run_read_video_from_path: run read_video_from_path to load video frames from a file path into a stacked numpy array
run_save_video: run save_video to write a sequence of RGB frames to an MP4 file at a specified FPS
